chants.vernacular_text: We have received your mercy, O God, in the midst of your temple; even as your name, so also does your praise extend to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness. ℣. Great is the Lord and worthy of all praise, in the city of our God, on his holy mountain.
Be unto me a protecting God, and a house of refuge, to save me. ℣. My God, in you do I trust; O Lord, let me never be put to shame.
Come unto me, all you who labour and are heavily burdened, and I will comfort you.
Great is the Lord and worthy of all praise; in the city of God, on his holy mountain.
You will save the humble nation, O Lord, and bring down the eyes of the proud. For who is God, other than you, O Lord?
O taste and see how gracious the Lord is; blessed is the man who trusts in him.
